description: me and my teams interest into astrophysics, cosmology, and things about space
summary:
We created a storybook that follows a spacecraft as it travels through the cosmos. Of heavy scary textbooks the spacecraft becomes a friendly guide. It shares its experiences, sensors and mission logs to explain difficult astrophysics, engineering and space exploration ideas.

This method tackles the problem of making STEM and space science easy and fun for normal people. By giving the spacecraft a voice and feelings technical facts turn into a great story. It bridges the gap between science and human curiosity.

The project matters because people love space when they feel connected. When readers see the how and why of space missions through a story it sparks lasting interest in science. It builds knowledge fuels public fascination, with space and inspires future explorers and engineers.
details:
What it does & how it works: Our project is an illustrated storybook narrated in the first person by NASA’s iconic spacecraft, starting with the Mars Rover Opportunity. Readers experience launches, landings, and scientific discoveries directly through the explorer's own voice, with real NASA mission timelines and telemetry woven into the plot.
Benefits & intended impact: Unlike dense, jargon-heavy textbooks that students quickly forget, our story-driven approach makes space science emotional and easy to understand—improving learning retention and sparking lasting STEM curiosity in young learners.
NASA data used: We grounded every chapter in official NASA/JPL Mission Archives, NASA Solar System Exploration, and the NASA Image and Video Library to keep all dates, traverse routes, discoveries, and spacecraft visuals scientifically accurate.
Creativity & factors considered: Instead of treating spacecraft as cold machines, we gave them human-relatable personalities and emotional journeys. Our team carefully balanced scientific accuracy, age-appropriate language, and authentic visual references so the book is both educational and unforgettable
